answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 49132 Country: India Title: How to get paak (clean/pure) if mazi secret in underwear, and can I offer salah in same cloth? Question: How to get paak (clean/pure) if mazi secret in underwear, and can I offer salah in same cloth? Answer ID: 49132 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1476/1476/M=12/1434) Mazi is napaak (unclean), if it touches the underwear you should wash the place which is smeared and after washing the particular area you can offer salah in the same cloth. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
